crossRefs.note: Of the children of Manasseh, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of…
those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.
“Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh. The prince of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of…
His division, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

translations.web: These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
translations.bsb: These were the clans of Manasseh, and their registration numbered 52,700.
translations.kjv: These are the families of Manasseh, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.
translations.asv: These are the families of Manasseh; and they that were numbered of them were fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.
